Name: D1 · Birra & Brace — late option near the hotel
Notes: D1 hedge. Roadside grill/pizzeria 2 min from the hotel, the kind of place that stays open late. Have reception (+39 031 851700) ring ahead — Monday is the standard closing day in Brianza. Better plan: eat at Malpensa.

Name: D2 · Dac a Tra' — Michelin star, 10 min from the hotel
SearchQuery: Dac a Tra Castello di Brianza
Notes: The closest starred restaurant to your base. Contemporary, produce-driven. +39 039 5312410.

Name: D3 · Il Cavatappi / Vecchia Varenna
Notes: D3 dinner. Il Cavatappi is tiny, in a stone alley — the romantic one. Vecchia Varenna is on the water in a former black-marble works. Varenna after dark is the prettiest village on the lake.

Name: D5 · Nives — Selva village square
SearchQuery: Ristorante Nives Selva di Val Gardena
Notes: CONFIRMED OPEN YEAR-ROUND, which in this valley in October is not a small thing. South Tyrolean + Mediterranean, homemade pasta. +39 0471 773329.

Name: D6 · Abbazia di Novacella — monastery + winery
Notes: Augustinian monastery with a rotunda library, baroque church AND its own winery doing tastings. Historic, indoors, wine — arguably a better rainy morning than the hike is a sunny one.

Name: D6 · Cantina Tramin — Termeno
Notes: One of Italy's best co-ops in a striking modern building. Tastings in the wine shop WITHOUT booking, Sat 09:00-17:00, closed Sunday. An hour south — hard to combine with Val di Funes.

Name: D8 · El Brite de Larieto — on the Tre Croci road
Notes: D8 dinner, effectively on your doorstep. Agriturismo with its own dairy. Open until late October, CLOSED WEDNESDAYS. Book: +39 368 7008083.

Name: D10 · SanBrite — Michelin star, 'agricucina'
Notes: Everything from the family farm, own cheese dairy. Tasting EUR90-120. Sister to El Brite, 10 min from Passo Tre Croci. CALL +39 0436 863882 to confirm October opening.

Name: D10 · Baita Fraina — above Cortina
Notes: D10 dinner (El Brite is closed Wednesdays). Mountain-lodge regional cooking in small panelled rooms, Michelin Guide listed.

Name: D11 · Rifugio Ospitale — SS51 north of Cortina
Notes: 11th-century hospice turned restaurant, road-accessible, tends to have a longer season than the mountain huts. A good long-lunch answer on a wet day.

Name: D12 · All'Arco — San Polo 436
Notes: D13, 11:00. Standing-room counter, no written menu, everything made that morning. EUR1.50-4 each. NO RESERVATIONS, CLOSED SUNDAY, and the shutters come down ~14:00 when the trays are empty.

Name: D12 · Osteria alla Vedova — Cannaregio
Notes: D12 evening. The legendary deep-fried polpetta. EUR2-5 a cicchetto. Closed Thursday (fine for you). Carry cash.

Name: D12 · Vino Vero — Fondamenta Misericordia
Notes: D12 evening. Natural wine bar, crostini with stracciatella, anchovy, lardo. Open daily 12:00-24:00.

Name: D12 · Al Timon — Fondamenta dei Ormesini
Notes: D12 evening. Everyone sits on the canal edge and on the moored boat. Daily 11:00-01:00.

Name: D12 · Antiche Carampane — the big dinner
Notes: D12, 20:30. The one with the sign saying no pizza, no lasagne, no tourist menu. Outstanding fried fish. ~EUR70-90pp. BOOK WEEKS AHEAD. Closed Sun-Mon, so Friday works.

Name: D14 · Valeggio sul Mincio — 'nodo d'amore' tortellini
Notes: D14 lunch, 15 min from Peschiera. Home of tortellini di Valeggio, the love-knot, with its own legend about a nymph and a knight. About as on-theme as a honeymoon lunch gets.

Name: D14 · Guerrieri Rizzardi — Bardolino
Notes: D14, 15:00. Aristocratic estate, tastings DAILY 10:00-18:30 — one of the very few open on a Sunday. From ~EUR15 for 90 min. Book: visite@guerrieri-rizzardi.it.

Name: D14 · Cantina Zeni wine museum — Bardolino
Notes: D14. Free museum and enoteca, no booking needed — the one drop-in option on the lake.

Name: D15 · Zenato — Peschiera del Garda
Notes: D15, 10:00. Lugana AND Valpolicella/Amarone under one roof — the best single tasting on the lake. Classic tour EUR40 (4 wines + food, 90 min). MON-SAT ONLY, booking essential.

Name: D15 · Franciacorta — Ca' del Bosco / Bellavista, Erbusco
Notes: D15, ~13:00. Italy's best metodo classico, ~40 min along the A4 towards MXP. Turns dead driving time into the last good thing you do. WHOEVER DRIVES DOESN'T TASTE.
